nullExpiry.sql: UPDATE assets SET retention_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND r2_key_original=? AND sha256=? AND status='analyzed' AND retention_expires_at=?

restoreExpiry.sql: UPDATE assets SET retention_expires_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND r2_key_original=? AND sha256=? AND status='analyzed' AND retention_expires_at IS NULL

started.sql: INSERT INTO asset_deletion_attempts(id,asset_id,status,object_keys_json,error_message,attempted_at,completed_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT ?,?,'started',?,?,?,NULL,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assets WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND status='analyzed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_deletion_attempts WHERE id=?)
params: JRN04-PROD-SYNTHETIC controlled intent fixture; no live deletion job or real storage failure.

failed.sql: UPDATE asset_deletion_attempts SET status='failed',completed_at=?,updated_at=?,error_message=? WHERE id=? AND asset_id=? AND status='started' AND error_message LIKE 'JRN04-PROD-SYNTHETIC%'
params: JRN04-PROD-SYNTHETIC controlled failed-state fixture; no production fault injected.

archiveSku.sql: UPDATE products SET status='archived',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND name=? AND sku_label=? AND current_profile_version_id IS NULL AND revision=0

referenceAudit.sql: INSERT INTO asset_deletion_attempts(id,asset_id,status,object_keys_json,error_message,attempted_at,completed_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT ?,?,'started',?,NULL,?,NULL,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assets WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND status='analyzed' AND sha256=? AND r2_key_original=?) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_deletion_attempts WHERE id=?)

referenceMark.sql: UPDATE assets SET status='deleted',deleted_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND status='analyzed' AND sha256=? AND r2_key_original=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asset_deletion_attempts WHERE id=? AND asset_id=? AND status='started')

referenceComplete.sql: UPDATE asset_deletion_attempts SET status='completed',completed_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND asset_id=? AND status='started' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assets WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=? AND status='deleted')
